Trigger You are about to cast a spell using focus points, or cast a focus spell.

Requirements You possess a qualifying catalyst on hand, worn, or within reach, see below.

Frequency Once per hour

You can use items and components that possess a suitable amount of ether to help charge your spell. To qualify, the catalyst must possess the catalyst, talisman, or fulu trait and must share at least one trait that matches the spell being cast that is not concentrate, manipulate or a spell tradition trait. The item must also be at least twice the level of the spell being cast or possess the same spell rank or higher. Alternatively, the catalyst can also be an item can interact with the spell as part of its casting, such as a catalyst designed specifically for a spell.

As you cast the spell, you negate 1 point of the focus point cost. This consumes, uses, or activates the item, whichever applies. If the item can be used as part of the spell, such as a qualifying catalyst for the spell it is made for, the spell still benefits from the catalyst’s effects as if you had Activated it. At 10th level, you negate up to 2 points of focus point costs with one use of this action.
